verdict.rationale: The Playground UI only offers a minimal state+question flow (jev-docs-21/jev-supp-playground), and the exact same actions (paste state, ask a Noul/Choice/Score question) are fully exposed via the Python/JS SDKs and the raw `/v1/systemone` and `/v1/models` endpoints (jev-docs-5, jev-docs-20, jev-docs-30, jev-supp-models-endpoint), so the API is a strict superset of what the UI provides rather than a limited subset. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement confirming full UI/API parity, independent hands-on confirmation that no UI-only settings (e.g., account/billing) exist outside the API.
